description: This file defines the `ChangedContacts` activity in an Android application that demonstrates querying the contacts database for entries that have changed or been deleted since a specific timestamp. It implements loader callbacks to asynchronously load and display contact changes and deletions, with UI components including buttons, list view, and adapters for displaying contact data.

classes.name: ChangedContacts
classes.description: Main activity class managing the UI and loader interactions to display contacts that changed or were deleted since a timestamp.

classes.name: DeleteCursorWrapper
classes.description: Wraps the cursor returned from deleted contacts query, remapping column indexes for compatibility.

classes.name: DeleteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to bind deleted contact data to list view items.

classes.name: ChangeAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to bind changed contact data to list view items.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, adapters, and sets up the layout.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers broadcast receiver for contacts database creation events.

methods.name: changeClick
methods.description: Handles the 'Changed since' button click, restarting loader to fetch changed contacts.

methods.name: deleteClick
methods.description: Handles the 'Deleted since' button click, restarting loader to fetch deleted contacts.

methods.name: saveLastTimestamp
methods.description: Stores the latest timestamp in shared preferences.

methods.name: getLastTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the last saved timestamp from shared preferences.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates and returns loader instances based on the request ID.

methods.name: getChangeLoader
methods.description: Constructs a loader for contacts changed since the last timestamp.

methods.name: getDeleteLoader
methods.description: Constructs a loader for contacts deleted since the last timestamp.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Handles the cursor data when a loader finishes loading, updating UI and internal timestamps.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Resets adapters when loaders are reset.
